name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics Tables
known_limitations: OEWS estimates cover wage and salary employment and are subject to sampling, suppression, area definitions, and release lags. Cross-industry area estimates do not establish staffing, vacancies, hiring, retention, or wage offers at a named facility.
automation_notes: Capture the release vintage, area, occupation or industry code, estimate, suppression status, and methodology. Do not infer facility workforce sufficiency.
notes: Phase 55I promotion from the private source-candidate registry.
